title: Faynt: Scaling and Optimizing Policies for Competitive Melee
abstract: arXiv:2610.02144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Faynt, a family of 10M- and 75M-parameter Transformer policies for Super Smash Bros. Melee, each controlling all 26 characters with a single checkpoint. After reinforcement learning (RL), the 10M wins 240 of 244 same-character games (98.4%) against fourteen specialist and multi-character releases on their supported rosters, with a winning record against every release. These opponents retain 21- or 24-frame action delays; Faynt uses no added delay, and we have not isolated the effect of this difference. In a separate evaluation against a privately supplied zero-delay Slippi-AI model, the 10M wins all 68 games across two conditioning settings. We study architecture, optimization, scaling, and hyperparameter transfer to guide pretraining on approximately 840,000 human replays. Post-training combines rank- and outcome-based curricula, 75M-to-10M distillation, and RL restricted to Fox mirror matches. On the initial 152-game bench

translated_title: Faynt：面向竞技《任天堂明星大乱斗Melee》的策略扩展与优化
translated_abstract: 我们推出了Faynt，这是一系列用于《任天堂明星大乱斗Melee》（Super Smash Bros. Melee）的1000万和7500万参数Transformer策略，每个模型仅通过单一检查点即可控制全部26个角色。经过强化学习（RL）后，1000万参数模型在与14个专家型及多角色已发布模型在其各自支持的角色阵容上进行同角色对战时，在244场比赛中赢得240场（98.4%），对所有已发布模型均保持获胜记录。这些对手保留了21帧或24帧的动作延迟；而Faynt未增加延迟，我们尚未分离这一差异所产生的影响。在与一个私下提供的零延迟Slippi-AI模型的单独评估中，1000万参数模型在两种条件设置下赢得了全部68场比赛。我们研究了架构、优化、扩展和超参数迁移，以指导基于约84万条人类对局录像的预训练。后训练阶段结合了基于排名和基于结果的课程学习、从7500万到1000万模型的蒸馏，以及仅限于Fox镜像对局的强化学习。在最初的152场比赛基准……
tldr: Faynt是一系列仅用单一检查点就能控制全部26个角色的Transformer策略，经过人类对局预训练、课程学习、蒸馏和强化学习后，在同角色对战中以98.4%的胜率击败14个已发布对手，并对零延迟Slippi-AI模型实现全胜。
en_tdlr: Faynt is a family of 10M- and 75M-parameter Transformer policies for Super Smash Bros. Melee that control all 26 characters with a single checkpoint, achieving a 98.4% win rate against fourteen released opponents in same-character matches and sweeping all 68 games against a zero-delay Slippi-AI model through pretraining on human replays, curriculum learning, distillation, and RL.
